claim: The maximum air temperature in Dublin on 2026-08-25 (UTC day) will be above 20.1°C.
resolution_criterion: YES if the value at JSON pointer /daily/temperature_2m_max/0 in the Open-Meteo response for latitude 53.35, longitude -6.26, start_date=2026-08-25, end_date=2026-08-25, timezone=UTC is strictly greater than 20.1. NO otherwise. The threshold was set to the forecast value published for 2026-08-25 at the time of writing, so the honest probability is close to a half. This is a canary: it is unscored and exists to exercise the pipeline daily.
